label: AbiI system
definition: An abortive infection system in which an organism possesses an abiI-family locus represented by the DefenseFinder AbiI__AbiI profile and exemplified by the Lactococcus lactis M138 pND852 locus whose single abiI open reading frame restricts lactococcal phage propagation by an abortive-infection mechanism.
observations: AbiI branch under abortive infection system; distinct from the individual abiI gene, AbiI protein, the pND852 and pND817 plasmids, the DefenseFinder AbiI__AbiI HMM profile, source database rows naming one AbiI locus, individual lactococcal phage host-range outcomes, unresolved AbiI triggers or arrest targets, and generic abortive infection systems.
